accept_preconditions: all valid lanes have legal common tag and time plus valid event fences
all valid lanes fit in the eight-entry ingress on the same edge
atomic_bundle.ingress_to_context_rule: Move lanes in stable order into matching or free per-phase contexts. At most four distinct destinations per phase are resident; excess cross-event lanes remain valid in the charged ingress until a context completes its partial RMW.
atomic_bundle.backpressure_rule: If any precondition is false, accept no lane. After an accept, backpressure the next whole bundle until ingress and all contexts in the epoch drain; malformed input faults fail-closed.
atomic_bundle.context_release_rule: Release only after every accepted contributor has completed a charged exact psum partial RMW or fault-drain disposition.
atomic_bundle.semantic_close_rule: Only canonical contributor frontier or tag-time-stream fence may final-commit a destination.
